text:
Priya: Quick sync — need to decide how we split work for Search Autocomplete post-launch. Customers report higher-latency suggestions and a couple of "bad suggestion" edge-cases. Thinking: two-track plan (critical bug fixes vs quality enhancements). Thoughts?
Tom: Can you share repro signal? hard to scope without failure rate / sample queries.
Priya: TL;DR: ~0.6% of queries show >200ms extra latency, but those are concentrated on long prefixes from enterprise customers. Repro is intermittent.
Jess: I pulled logs this morning. Service p95 jumps when prefix length > 30 and when cache miss happens. sample:```
2026-03-20T10:12:03Z INFO autocomplete request id=abc123 prefix_len=34 cache=false p95=340ms
```
Tom: Ok that points at caching / KV eviction patterns. If we treat as bug, we need a hotfix that changes cache TTL or adds a small LRU tweak. Low dev effort? estimate 1-2 days + canary.
Liam: From UX side, some of the "bad suggestions" are actually ranking choices — we could reduce harm quickly by lowering prominence of aggressive completions (visual change). Low effort but not fixing root cause.
Maria: Suggest a priority matrix: Impact x Repro. My read: latency = high impact / medium repro (bug track). ranking oddities = medium impact / high repro (enhancement track).
Priya: Proposal: Sprint A (2 weeks): fast bug track -> caching tweak + stricter circuit-breaker for long prefixes (owner: Tom). Also add extra telemetry to trace long-prefix path (owner: Jess). Sprint B: UX + ranking improvements + broader eval on historical queries (owner: Liam + Maria).
Tom: 👍 on owners. For caching tweak, we should validate perf locally first. I'll open a PR and add a small experiment flag.
Jess: I'll add tracing and a dashboard widget for prefix length buckets. Once we have 24h of traces, we can decide rollout.
Priya: Acceptance criteria for bug track: p95 for long-prefix bucket reduces from >300ms to <180ms in canary, and no regressions on short prefixes. For ranking improvements: 80% reduction in reported "incorrect suggestion" tickets in pilot cohort.
Maria: Can we also add a lightweight A/B to the UI change to measure click-through before full rollout?
Liam: Yes — we can ship a config flag for UI prominence and test with 5% traffic. Designer will provide mock by EOD.
Priya: Action items: 1) Tom -> PR for cache flag (due +48h). 2) Jess -> tracing + dashboard (due +24h). 3) Liam/Maria -> UI mock + A/B plan (due +48h). 4) Priya -> update roadmap doc and customer comms draft (due +72h). I'll ping stakeholders after the first 24h signals. :eyes: @release-bot can you create the canary ticket and link here?
release-bot: Created ticket INF-8231 and canary job infra/canary/autocomplete-long-prefix. Details: https://redwood.internal/INF-8231
Tom: Thanks — starting work now.
Priya: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after initial telemetry.
